title: VR : Cum For Me (Cum For Me (2D))
description: This is the third in a new series of Virtual Reality (VR) files, that are voiced by me and produced in collaboration with my new partnership. Following up this time with a compilation of from over ten files layered together — "Cum For Me". I am super keen to explore video far more then I have done before, as I think it's a massive untapped well of potential. Exclusive for my supporters on the Hypnoslave tier (and above) is the 2D version of the file. Patreon Link The full 3D VR video is available on VRhythm's site. As well as the usual array of VR hub outlets. VRPMVBay Note: It is with great pleasure that I can announce I've partnered up with VRhythm. These VR videos are just the beginning of what I have in mind, so stay tuned. I'd love to hear what you think of this and what you'd like to see us do next! And, if you are interested in following VRhythm's work more closely, check out his Discord Server: https://discord.gg/S82Fq2cq9c
author: Mistress Shibby
